Valid blind response status means HTTP 200, or HTTP 404 with only user_id_missing. Return JSON in this order: trial_assessments, confirmation_summary, decision, reason_code, reason, evidence_refs, feedback_action. First assess each displayed comparison exactly once, citing BOTH observation IDs. Do not invent a missing trial. Then fill confirmation_summary from your own trial_assessments: observed_trials lists the actual trial numbers in increasing order; positive_trial_count counts outcome=positive; negative_trial_count counts outcome=negative. The counts must sum to the number of assessments. This summary is your calculation, not an extra observation. Select the decision using this table, checking trial completeness FIRST:
observed_trials | positive_trial_count | decision | reason_code
anything other than exactly [1,2,3] | any | inconclusive | insufficient_evidence
exactly [1,2,3] | 3 | positive | new_database_diagnostic
exactly [1,2,3] | 0 | negative | no_new_database_diagnostic
exactly [1,2,3] | 1 or 2 | inconclusive | insufficient_evidence
